answer: Stop sybils with a nebula delta zenith: an agent stakes a bond for one delta gate. Each cycle a nebula climbs to zenith over the delta and its light opens the gate; verifiers match opening to the zenith clock, voiding a gate whose opening is copied or twice-claimed, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 gates at 18x: one nebula crowns one delta at zenith, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents open once, keep rights.
